verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-1 credential-routing defect is fixed. `scripts/worker-pr.py` now keeps the private `ALERT_TOKEN` separate from `REGISTRY_ALERT_TOKEN`, returns the registry-scoped token on every rejected private route, and retains the private token only for a positively verified private destination. The self-test uses distinct token sentinels, checks the visibility probe's repository and credential, covers same-repo/public/failed/indeterminate routes, and exercises the fallback through production wiring. The analogous plan and groom routers fail closed to the public registry under their ambient workflow credential. I found no diff-supported correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue requiring changes.
